mapper.select: SELECT sys09_code FROM sys09_code INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_code NOT IN (SELECT bbs12_app_type FROM bbs12_application_form WHERE bbs12_company_id = #{companyId}) ORDER BY sys09_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs12_application_form (bbs12_application_form_id, bbs12_company_id, bbs12_app_type, bbs12_public_yn) VALUES (#{applicationFormId}, #{companyId}, #{appType}, 'false')
mapper.select: SELECT bbs12_application_form_id AS application_form_id , bbs12_company_id AS company_id , bbs12_app_type AS app_type , f_cdnm('ApplicationType', bbs12_app_type, bbs12_company_id, f_today()) AS app_type_name , bbs12_content AS content , bbs12_content_mobi AS content_mobi , COALESCE(bbs12_public_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS public_yn FROM bbs12_application_form INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'ApplicationType' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'false' ) ) ) sys ON sys09_code = bbs12_app_type WHERE bbs12_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY bbs12_app_type
